title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 066
review_goal: Differentiate hemisphere, hexagons, and history variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Side hemisphere shell with one vertical inner curve centered inside the form
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a vertical half sphere seen from the side with one inner dividing curve.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the bowl hemisphere when the opening rim should lie across the top.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot turns the hemisphere upright and marks the inner curve down the middle.

items.depicts_observation: Three separate hexagon cells with one top cell above two lower cells
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants three detached hexagon cells arranged in a triangle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the joined hexagon cluster when the cells should share borders.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot spaces the hexagons apart with one above and two below.

items.depicts_observation: Three joined hexagon cells with one top cell touching two lower cells
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a honeycomb style cluster where the hexagons share borders.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the separated hexagon cells when visible gaps should remain between the shapes.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot connects the three hexagons into one clustered honeycomb shape.

items.depicts_observation: Clock ring with one curved outer arrow and one centered hand inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants history shown as a clock face with one outer return arrow.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rewind clock when the arrow should sit at the upper left and the inner ticks should show.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot combines a clock hand with one outer circular arrow around the ring.

items.depicts_observation: Open clock ring with one upper left arrow and three inner tick marks
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants history shown as an open clock ring with a top left arrow.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the closed history clock when a centered hand should appear inside the ring.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot opens the ring and adds an arrowhead at the upper left plus three inner ticks.
